title: Integration
description: An external system reached through an MCP server configured in Claude Code. Opt-in via enable.integrations. Enabling it adds the granted MCP tools to the named roles (and their variants) and its rule to every agent's Project rules.

mcp.description: MCP server name; tools are named mcp__<mcp>__<tool>.

tools.description: Named tool sets, e.g. read and write. Tools that delete data should not be listed at all.

grants.description: Role id -> tool sets it receives, e.g. { analyst: [read] }. Grant write sets only to roles whose steps are gated by a human.

allow.description: Tool sets pre-approved in the managed settings file (permissions.allow), so agents can use them without a prompt. Keep sets that change the external system out of it: those should always ask a human.

rule.description: Added under 'Project rules' in every agent's context while enabled.
